snippet.title: The Shadow Syndicate | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.
